scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.docker:reset: PATH="/Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin:$PATH" docker compose down -v && PATH="/Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin:$PATH" docker compose up -d
scripts.test:quick: npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register backend/src/game/elo.spec.ts && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register backend/src/game/millEngine.spec.ts && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register backend/src/game/connectFourEngine.spec.ts && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register backend/src/game/grailQuestEngine.spec.ts && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:full: npm run test:quick && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register backend/src/game/authApi.spec.ts && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register backend/src/game/gamesApi.spec.ts && npm run lint && npm run build
